battery_voltage.label: Float charge [A3]
battery_voltage.hint: A3 bat_single_battery_float_charge_setting (x2 = 24 V pack) - float/maintenance charge target

battery_voltage.label: Return to inverter [A6]
battery_voltage.hint: A6 bat_power_supply_value (x2 = 24 V pack) - leave mains bypass when pack >= this

battery_voltage.label: Low battery recovery [A5]
battery_voltage.hint: A5 bat_low_voltage_recovery_value (x2 = 24 V pack) - recover output after low-voltage protection

battery_voltage.label: Switch to grid [A7]
battery_voltage.hint: A7 bat_mains_power_supply_value (x2 = 24 V pack) - mains bypass when pack <= this

battery_voltage.label: Low voltage protection [A4]
battery_voltage.hint: A4 bat_low_voltage_protection_value (x2 = 24 V pack) - inverter output cutoff floor

battery_soc.label: Resume inverter
battery_soc.hint: lithium_battery_conthigh - battery/inverter resumes when SOC >= this

battery_soc.label: Switch to grid
battery_soc.hint: lithium_battery_contlow - switch to mains when SOC <= this
